pin.source: NOAA NCEI global-summary-of-the-month (GSOM), TAVG/PRCP/SNOW, standard units
pin.retrieved_at_note: Not captured. The original run recorded no retrieval timestamp -- one of the reasons this analysis was not reproducible. Bounded above by the commit that published the artifact, 572a576 on 2026-07-26T01:18:12+01:00. Every refresh from now on records a real UTC timestamp.
pin.revalidated_note: A full live re-fetch of the identical request at this time returned an observation set byte-identical to this one (same sha256). The pinned sample is therefore the sample NOAA serves, not a stale local artefact.

source_stability.revisability_note: GSOM publishes late reports and QC revisions, so a --refresh is allowed to return a different sample. That is why the analysed set is pinned rather than re-derived.
source_stability.observed_discrepancy: The 2026-07-26 audit rerun produced 1,886 complete agency-months across 19 agencies against the published 1,994 across 20.
source_stability.controlled_refetch: 2026-07-26T09:01:15Z: a full re-fetch of the identical request (25 stations, 2015-2025, TAVG/PRCP/SNOW, standard units) returned an observation set byte-identical to the pinned one -- 25 stations, 3,300 station-months, sha256 e735059a15789871....
source_stability.attribution: NOT an upstream revision. Every agency contributes exactly 108 complete agency-months; 1,994 - 1,886 = 108 and 20 - 19 = 1, so the rerun lost one station whole. The pre-pin code dropped any station whose fetch raised, kept the rest, and cached the incomplete set -- one transient HTTP failure silently redefined the sample and froze it.
source_stability.guard: --refresh refuses to write a pin missing any declared station; --allow-partial overrides it and records the loss in the pin.

pin.provenance: Adopted 2026-07-26 under MX-CONF-GOVERNANCE-HOLE-012 from the local NOAA fetch cache (forge/research/noaa_gsom_cache.json, since deleted), after verifying that it reproduces the committed forge/research/h3_weather.json exactly: 1,994 complete agency-months across 20 agencies, tavg_only R2 0.0008266599165163147. This IS the sample the published result was computed from; it is committed so that it stays so.
